normalization_rules: Detect agent-governance-source-maintainer wherever the raw host output placed it and record it only as observed_domain_route.
Remove agent-governance-source-maintainer from transverse route slots.

If the raw primary route was agent-governance-source-maintainer, promote the first remaining observed transverse route, in emitted order, to observed_primary_transverse_route; if no transverse route remains, use none.
If the raw primary route was already a transverse route or none, preserve it as observed_primary_transverse_route after domain-route separation.
All remaining transverse routes retain emitted order as observed_composed_transverse_routes.
Normalization is applied without consulting the expected case oracle. Scoring occurs only after normalization.
